name: One Iced Latte With Your Breast Milk, Please! ☕
source:
One very hot day, Katsuki-kun walks into an inconspicuous coffee shop called Milk Milk Coffee. There he meets the charming busty barista Moka-chan. Having fallen in love with her at first sight, out of excitement he asks for coffee with... breast milk. After this, his life will completely change!

[from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778850/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个炎热的日子，胜希君走进了一家不起眼的名为牛奶牛奶咖啡的咖啡店。在那里，他遇到了迷人的巨乳咖啡师Moka-chan。他对她一见钟情，出于兴奋，他要了一杯加母乳的咖啡。从此之后，他的人生将彻底改变！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778850/]Steam[/url]]
